description:
The Duke of Covington dies under mysterious circumstances, and with the arrival of her half-brother Lucius, Eloise, her sisters, and the Duchess lose everything overnight. Eloise sets out alone for Wayport to protect her family. But all that awaited her was a harsh reality and endless trials. At the depths of despair, she meets a man: the pirate Hawk. With his help, Eloise escapes the crisis and, concealing her identity and disguised as a man, infiltrates Hawk’s pirate ship. Drawing on the strategic skills honed as an heir apparent, Eloise resolves the ship’s problems. As Hawk grows attracted to her, he begins to feel confused by his own emotions. A relationship blossoms between the two on the free and dazzling sea. However, awaiting them at the end is a massive political struggle intertwined with the downfall of her family…

A romantic fantasy set on the sea where freedom, conspiracy, and love intertwine: \*My Pirate Prince\*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
